mapper.select:
SELECT * FROM ( SELECT R.ALRM_RCVR_ID, A.ALRM_ID, A.ALRM_TTLN, A.ALRM_TYPE_CD, A.ALRM_CN, A.TARGET_TYPE, A.TARGET_ID, A.PARENT_TARGET_ID, A.ALRM_SNDNG_DT, R.ALRM_CFMTN_DT FROM TB_ALRM_RCVR R JOIN TB_ALRM A ON A.ALRM_ID = R.ALRM_ID WHERE R.RCVR_EMP_ID = #{empId} AND R.ALRM_DEL_YN = 'N' ORDER BY A.ALRM_SNDNG_DT DESC )
WHERE ROWNUM <= #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_ALRM A JOIN TB_ALRM_RCVR R ON A.ALRM_ID = R.ALRM_ID WHERE R.RCVR_EMP_ID = #{rcvrEmpId} AND R.ALRM_DEL_YN = 'N' AND R.ALRM_CFMTN_DT IS NULL
mapper.insert:
SELECT SEQ_ALRM_ID.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO TB_ALRM ( ALRM_ID, ALRM_TTLN, ALRM_TYPE_CD, ALRM_CN, TARGET_TYPE, TARGET_ID, PARENT_TARGET_ID, ALRM_SNDNG_DT ) VALUES ( #{alrmId}, #{alrmTtln}, #{alrmTypeCd}, #{alrmCn}, #{targetType}, #{targetId}, #{parentTargetId}, #{alrmSndngDt} )

SELECT SEQ_ALRM_RCVR_ID.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO TB_ALRM_RCVR ( ALRM_RCVR_ID, ALRM_ID, RCVR_EMP_ID, ALRM_DEL_YN ) VALUES ( #{alrmRcvrId}, #{alrmId}, #{rcvrEmpId}, 'N' )
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_ALRM_RCVR SET ALRM_CFMTN_DT = SYSDATE WHERE RCVR_EMP_ID = #{rcvrEmpId} AND ALRM_DEL_YN = 'N' AND ALRM_CFMTN_DT IS NULL
